CHAPTER 01 - THE INVITATION

A Journey Shaped Around You

This journey was designed to leave room for both discovery and rest.

Dear Sara,

I am delighted to present this privately arranged journey: " Vietnam Rails, Mountains and Shores with Saigon Finale", created for 2 passengers travelling from 30 Mar – 12 Apr 2027. The route unfolds from Hanoi – Halong Bay – Sapa – Da Nang – Hoi An – Ho Chi Minh City.

The programme has been considered around an active rhythm: early check-in in Hanoi, private guiding and transfers, a premium overnight train cabin, and enough space between active days to pause. Dining, room arrangements and transitions have been planned with care, without adding unnecessary movement.

Please review the journey as a starting point for a personal conversation. Every final detail can be refined around your preferred pace, room choices and family priorities.

Eddie

Your Journey Designer · +84 913 393 119

CHAPTER 02 · DAY-BY-DAY ITINERARY

Day-by-Day Journey Program

Your private 14D13N journey — 14 days, carefully crafted.

Hanoi DAY 1

Day 1 — Hanoi

Arrival in Hanoi by CX741. Enjoy pre-booked Early Check-in at Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa and rest for half a day. In the evening, gather for a Welcome Dinner followed by an Evening Hanoi Short Walking Tour to ease into the local rhythm.

Highlights: Airport transfer · Early check · in · Welcome Dinner · Evening Walking Tour.

Notes:
  • Sense of Pace: Relaxed

Hanoi DAY 2

Day 2 — Ninh Binh

Full Day Ninh Binh Tour from Hanoi. Discover the historic ancient capital of Hoa Lu, the grand Bai Dinh Pagoda, serene sampan boat ride through Trang An landscape, and panoramic views from Mua Cave.

Highlights: Private AC transfer · guide · entrance tickets · Trang An boat tour · Lunch.

Selected Hotel Plan

Proposed hotels and luxury cruises selected for your journey. Subject to availability at confirmation.

Deluxe City View Double Room
HANOI, VIETNAM

Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa

Nestled in the historic Ba Dinh district, Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa blends French colonial charm with modern hospitality. It offers elegant rooms, a rooftop bar with spectacular city views, and a serene spa for a perfect urban retreat.

30 Mar – 01 Apr 2027 • 02 Apr – 04 Apr 2027 TEL: +84 28 3933 3226
Captain Suite
HA LONG, VIETNAM

Emeraude Classic Cruise

Emeraude Cruises is a premier luxury cruise line operating in Ha Long Bay, managed by Thien Minh Group (TMG). Inspired by the legendary 1906 French paddle steamer, Emeraude offers a refined journey blending Indochine vintage charm with modern elegance and top-tier safety standards.

01 Apr – 02 Apr 2027 TEL: +84 28 3933 3226
Suite Queen Cabin
TRAIN, VIETNAM

Chapa Express Train

Chapa Express Train offers premium overnight sleeper service between Hanoi and Lao Cai (Sapa). Featuring traditional wooden panels, comfortable air-conditioned cabins, clean amenities, and personalized passenger hospitality.

04 Apr – 05 Apr 2027 TEL: +84 28 3933 3226
Mountain View Bungalow
SAPA, VIETNAM

Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa

Located in the scenic mist-covered hills of Sapa, Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa features stunning panoramic views of Fansipan mountain and Muong Hoa valley. Designed with local heritage details, the hotel offers comfortable heated bungalows, an outdoor pool, and local gourmet dining.

05 Apr – 06 Apr 2027 TEL: +84 28 3933 3226
Superior King Room
DA NANG, VIETNAM

Radisson RED Danang Hotel

Radisson RED Danang Hotel offers refined luxury accommodations, personalized service, and modern comforts.

06 Apr – 08 Apr 2027 TEL: +84 28 3933 3226
Deluxe Balcony Queen Classic Wing
HOI AN, VIETNAM

La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa

La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa offers refined luxury accommodations, personalized service, and modern comforts.

08 Apr – 10 Apr 2027 TEL: +84 28 3933 3226
Premium King Room
HO CHI MINH CITY, VIETNAM

Mai House Hotel

Mai House Saigon Hotel is a luxury 5-star hotel ideally located in District 3, right next to the vibrant center of District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City. Featuring an elegant Neoclassical architecture with a touch of timeless nostalgia, Mai House offers guest spaces that blend modern luxury with warm hospitality and attentive service.

10 Apr – 12 Apr 2027 TEL: +84 28 3933 3226
Room Notes & Special Requests
Double Room / Twin sharing. Early check-in included in Hanoi.
